solutions.summary: Team owners and admins can invite people by email with a role. Invitees accept through a signed link.

steps.label: Who may invite people
steps.detail: Checks the members:invite permission, which config/teams.php grants to the owner and admin roles.

steps.label: Who may accept an invitation
steps.detail: Only the signed-in user whose email matches the invitation.

solutions.summary: Only the team owner can invite people or cancel invitations.

steps.label: Who may invite people
steps.detail: Checks the members:invite permission, which config/teams.php now grants to the owner only.
